TaskDescription: No task: unstructured, naturalistic behaviour during clinical long-term epilepsy monitoring; one file per recording day (midnight to midnight).

DiscontinuityZeroing.Description: data within 2 s of high-amplitude discontinuities (>50 IQR electrode-averaged absolute voltage) set to 0

Notch.Description: notch filter at 60 Hz and harmonics

SourceElectrodeFilteringColumn.Description: NWB electrodes table "filtering" column, verbatim: 250 Hz lowpass

iEEGReference: Common median reference computed separately for each grid, strip or depth electrode group (applied by the authors; Peterson et al. 2022). The acquisition reference is not documented.
iEEGElectrodeGroups: Grid: ECoG grid; LAT: left anterior temporal; LATD: left anterior temporal depth; LMTD: left medial temporal depth; LPT: left posterior temporal; LTPD: left temporal pole depth
iEEGPlacementScheme: Clinically placed electrodes; participants selected for coverage near motor cortex.
SubjectArtefactDescription: Monitoring breaks are stored as NaN samples (see nan_segment events).
